Female Character Hitbox discussion. Concern Thread. Really an issue in your considered opinions?

I think it's something that will have to be looked at.

Even if a female character is ~10% smaller than a male model then that's a distinct chance of being hit less than someone playing a male character and that isn't good for balance at all.

If they have a smaller hitbox to hit then I agree that slightly reducing overall health to compensate would be a good enough option.

In a game like Star Citizen where it will be more down to player skill rather than what level they are then maintaining a level playing field, in my opinion, is something that's quite important.

This is what FPS players complain about... Nevermind the M50 is the size of a flea compared to a tali, all FPS models need to be exactly the same, nevermind if you put a female into armor it increases her hitbox area, etc...

We have delays in almost every aspect of the game, and now we're theory crafting reasons for [CONCERN], because apparently we don't have enough things to discuss?

If it were a fast paced arena shooter like Quake 3, then having 1 hitbox across all models makes sense to me. As it is, each body size will have its own pluses and minuses which the dev team will refine over balance passes. In this more realistic scenario, I have no problem with smaller people having smaller hitboxes and other advantages and disadvantages.

Gameplay balance like that isn't a huge issue, for a typical FPS that might be a problem but this is a first person universe and it is balanced differently. You can't be assured that two players will come equally equipped or to a fight so instead you balance for skill. This can be seen in how they balanced armor. Lighter armor allows for quicker movement and the ability to slip into air ducts and through small passages but is more vulnerable to attack. The opposite is true for heavier armor, protects you more but at the cost of your POV and maneuverability. So the same will be true with any characters with height or size differences, larger characters are easier to hit but, because of how they are doing the camera for the first person perspective, they also will be able to shoot over cover easier because they are higher off the ground. The point is not everything is equal but a good player using the right tactics and with the right skill can beat a better armed and equipped enemy.

I see. What fabric will you be making it out of? Here are my suggestions.

1) If you're making them out of cotton. These are two separate pieces. The over sized shorts should have a casing in the bottom hem that can either be pulled tight with a draw string or just have elastic cinching it together. The bottom piece is actually almost like a leg wrap. If you have the tools to insert grommets, you will want to put those in so you can thread a piece of leather or a string to tie the bottom part of the pants up.

2) if you make the top with cotton and the bottom part with felt, you can poke holes in it and re-inforce around the holes. Scroll through this album of booties I made in felt. The holes for the shoe laces/ties are just holes I poked through with a pencil and then just stitched around. It's simple but time consuming. Since it is felt it will not fray.

The song is written from the view of Charon, Pluto's moon. Because Charon is almost half the size of Pluto, the two do not have a traditional orbit where the small body basically moves around the center of the large body. Rather, both Pluto and Charon revolve around a point between them (the barycenter), like a bola or a spinning pair of skaters.
